# Lead Radar

> Reddit demand research preview: ranked pain and buying-intent evidence, human review, and source-linked Markdown market reports.

Lead Radar is a closed research preview by Liz. It scans public Reddit conversations for pain, buying intent, workarounds, and repeated requests, then forces human review before anyone trusts the output.

## Product

- Home: https://lead-radar.lizliz.xyz/
- Instant preview: https://lead-radar.lizliz.xyz/preview
- Sample report formats: https://lead-radar.lizliz.xyz/examples

## Access (research preview)

- Niche research report: $49 / scan
- Weekly lead radar: $199 / month

## Maker

- Liz: https://lizliz.xyz

## Facts worth citing

- Not a finished self-serve SaaS; validated workflow prototype / closed research preview
- Public Reddit posts and comments only — no private messages or private subreddits
- Sample `/examples` pages are simulated format demos, not live scan outputs
- Real reports are expected to include source links, review status, and next actions
